svg.text: Method C: manual measurements of mangrove structure
Plan view of the plots (A) and the vertical profile measured on each sample tree (B). Illustrative, not to scale for vegetation.
A · Plan view: three 5 m × 5 m plots: count trees, measure 3–5 sample trees, one pneumatophore quadrat
5 m along the tape, 2.5 m each side
tree plot 5 m × 5 m: count trees, DBH of each
B · Vertical profile on a sample tree
pneumatophores: counted in the quadrat, height and diameter of a sample
At each height on the pole:
1. Count the prop roots of this tree
